description: The install planner, variant selection and target mapping (plans/P4-01.md §2.9, §4.5; WIRE-CONTRACT-V4 §11.4, informative). Generated by `tools/gen-content-corpus.ts`; do not hand-edit. `rows` pin `plan(input)`: A7 §4.2 with `requestWeight` (default below; `caps.requestWeight` overrides) and `full` as `{bytes, requests?}` costing `requests ?? 1`; chunk targets and seeds are inline (`records` as `[id, len, clen, bundle, offset]`, `ids`), so the planner never parses an index. Results are verdicts, never exceptions: `{strategy, delta?, transport?, bytes, requests, cost, peakDisk, fallbacks}` or `{error}`. The `plan-real-*` rows are the content set's own menu through `planTarget`. `variantCases` pin `selectVariant(variants, prefs)` (`{index}` or `{error: "pack-no-variant"}`), `targetCases` `planTarget(variant, recordSha256, filesIndex, chunkIndex)`, where `chunkIndex` (`{payloadSize, payloadSha256, records}`, plans/P4-10.md §2.5) is absent, meaning null, on the cases before P4-10. Compare by canonical JSON. `feedDeltaCases` (plans/P4-29.md §4.3, appended) pin the feed's delta menu: `withFeedDeltas(variant, deltas)` → `{variant, feedIds}`, then `planTarget(merged, recordSha256, filesIndex, chunkIndex)` and `plan({target, installed, caps})`; `expect` is `{feedIds, target, plan}`.

rows.description: The installed payload already is the target.
The pack is bound to a platform transport the SDK supports.
Bound to a platform transport the SDK lacks: no silent CDN fallback.
delta 300,000 B beats chunk (3 contiguous missing chunks), file and full.
The only delta starts from a release that is not installed.
The delta needs more memory than the budget.
The SDK does not advertise zstd-patch-from.
No installed chunk index and no delta: file beats full.
Nothing installed: only full is feasible.
50 scattered missing chunks: request weight makes full cheaper than chunk.
delta and chunk cost exactly the same: rank prefers delta.
Three deltas from the installed base: the cheapest wins, equal cost keeps menu order.
Free disk admits delta and chunk but not file or full.
No strategy fits in free disk.
Two installed releases seed disjoint chunks; only c9 is fetched.
Duplicate ids are fetched once; a gap or a bundle change starts a new request run; a seeded record between two missing ones does not break their run.
full is cheaper than file, but fallbacks still list full last.
The SDK advertises no incremental strategy; full is always available.
As plan-delta-other-base with requestWeight 4 MiB: chunk's second request outweighs its 2.8 MB saving, so full wins.
The content set's own v1 → v2 menu (`djdl.levels@1.1.0` through `planTarget`, v1 installed; no chunk index in v1).
As plan-real-v1-v2 for an SDK without delta support.
A memory budget of the `files` set's `memBytes` excludes the whole-payload delta: the packed set remains.
As plan-real-no-delta with requestWeight 65536.
A tree's first install: full costs the full object plus its index, in two requests.
A tree with three of five files installed: file (no gaps object, so one request for the index and one per missing blob) beats the two-request full.
`djdl.levels@1.2.0` (v2 with its chunk index) through `planTarget`, v1 installed with its chunk ids: the whole delta wins, and chunk comes before file and full in the fallbacks.
As plan-real-chunk-v1-v2 for an SDK without delta support: chunk wins.
As plan-real-chunk-no-delta with requestWeight 65536: still chunk (index plus three runs), where plan-real-no-delta-64k takes full.

variantCases.description: The host's first preferred texture wins.
No variant's texture is in the host's list.
A declared axis the host has no preferences for.
Axes compare in name byte order: `locale` before `texture`, so fr+etc2 beats en+astc.
A variant requiring another engine is skipped.
A variant without `requires.engine` matches any host.
Outside Godot (engine null) only variants without an engine requirement are eligible.
Values compare by bytes: `ASTC` is not `astc`.
The preferred variant's layout is unknown: the next one wins.
A tree whose index format is `pkey-files/2` is unusable.

targetCases.description: A container planned without its index (a first install): `full` and the `payload` delta; `files` null drops the `files` delta.
A container with its index: `full`, `files` with gaps, and both deltas, the set's artifacts being index, gaps, descriptor and data.
A tree: `full` costs the object plus the index in two requests; no gaps; the set's artifacts are index, descriptor and data.
An unknown layout makes the variant unusable: everything null, no deltas.
An unknown `full` codec: `full` null, the deltas kept.
`full.size` differs from `payload.size`: `full` null.
Index format `pkey-files/2`: `files` null and the `files` delta dropped; `full` and the `payload` delta kept.
An unknown index codec: as target-files-format-unknown.
`files.size` above MAX_FILES_INDEX_BYTES: as target-files-format-unknown.
An unknown gaps codec on a container: the index is not rebuildable, as target-files-format-unknown.
An unknown descriptor codec drops that `files` delta; `files` kept.
A tree whose index is unreadable is unusable: everything null.
A delta of an unknown scope is dropped.
An unknown method is passed through for the planner's capabilities to refuse.
A container with a usable `chunks` ref and its parsed index: `chunks` is the index bytes and the four inline records (the dup payload repeats its first file, so two records share an id).
`chunks.format` is `pkey-chunks/2`: `chunks` null, the rest kept.
An unknown `chunks` codec (`lz4`): `chunks` null.
`chunks.size` above MAX_CHUNK_INDEX_BYTES: `chunks` null.
The parsed index is bound to another payload: `chunks` null.
No parsed index (it was not fetched): `chunks` null.
A `tree` variant carrying `chunks` (valid, ignored: v2 defines no tree chunking): `chunks` null.
One record's `len` is MAX_CHUNK_BYTES + 1: the strategy is unusable, `chunks` null (no code).

feedDeltaCases.description: No record delta; the feed offers one from the installed payload: the feed delta is planned.
The record's delta starts from a payload this device does not hold; the feed's starts from the one it does.
A record delta and a feed delta of equal cost, both bases installed: the record's keeps the lower order, so CI wins the tie and the feed delta is the next fallback.
A feed entry whose artifact is the record delta's id is not appended: the record delta wins.
The menu offers a delta to another payload only: the variant is unchanged.
A tree variant takes no feed delta (a `payload` delta needs a container).
An unusable variant (an unknown layout) takes no feed delta and maps to no candidate.
The feed delta's `memBytes` is above the memory budget: merged, never a candidate; `file` or `full` installs instead.
A feed entry of an unknown method (`hdiffpatch`) is merged, and the planner's `patchMethods` finds it infeasible.
The feed delta's base is not installed: merged, never a candidate.
A host without the `delta` strategy: the feed delta is merged and never a candidate.
No usable menu (`deltas` null): the record's own menu only.

The content set's v1 → v2 pair (`djdl.levels@1.2.0` with its record payload delta removed, v1 installed with its chunk ids and files) and P4-17's measured lazy frame (325,258 bytes, level 9) offered by the feed: the feed delta beats `chunk`, `file` and `full`.
